Goal: Build a complete inventory of every section, component, CSS module, image, font, animation, and constant that the homepage uses. We are comparing this to the original Webflow export to find pixel-perfect mismatches.

- src/app/page.tsx
- src/app/layout.tsx
- src/app/globals.css

- src/components/animations/ (list + read)

1. File path (with line numbers for key blocks)

4. Images referenced (path + alt + width/height/sizes)
5. Animations / framer-motion usage
6. Any inline styles or Tailwind classes
7. Any hardcoded text/copy that may not match the live site

Also report:
- What sections currently exist on the homepage in the rendered order (top to bottom)
- Any TODO/FIXME/console.log/any/ts-ignore in the homepage tree
- File sizes of each component (rough line count)

Output a structured markdown report with one subsection per homepage section. This is read-only research — do not modify any files. Be exhaustive — we will use this as the baseline for the diff.
